sources.title: さよならを教えて 攻略 (shisnap)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed Japanese PC walkthrough: common days 1-3, day-4 save, all five heroine routes and day-9 branch choices, day-11 endings, three save positions and one CG variant note. The walkthrough does not name its edition explicitly and appears to reflect the original Windows PC game; direct applicability of its literal choices and all ending behavior to the 2016 DLsite download edition remains UNVERIFIED.

sources.title: 『さよならを教えて』（2001）プレイ感想 (kqck, DLsite purchase)
sources.notes: Directly inspected detailed first-hand Japanese 2026 play log: author says the copy was purchased on DLsite and explicitly recounts the day-9 five-way heroine-selection prompt, selection of 御幸 and movement to 図書室, heroine-specific episodes and ending, plus a failed 望美 attempt that reached the bad ending and required replay from day 3. Important partial independent evidence for the Windows DL distribution, but product ID and all literal route-defining choices, affinity requirements, and endings are not verified; DOES NOT QUALIFY AS COMPLETE SET B.

sources.title: さよならを教えて ～comment te dire adieu～ (ゲームカタログ@Wiki)
sources.notes: Directly inspected independent Japanese release/system source: original 2001 PC, 2011 BD, 2016 Windows DL release; five heroine locations; up to three heroine progress tracks before day 9; the normal route ending requires choosing the heroine with whom the player is most familiar at the late branching decision. Prints a day-5 three-choice example and confirms choices may not match what the protagonist actually says. Supports gate-relevant preselection affinity behavior but NOT all exact choices, save states, or individual endings.

disagreements:
AUTHOR DRAFT / REVIEW GATE (2026-11-04): Following explicit repository-owner direction to proceed with draft files, guide.json and five route_*.json files exist, all reviewed:false. They are NOT approved or fully runnable: Miyuki's day-5 archery-club sequence still has three untranscribed source-listed explicit choices. Do not treat a filename's existence, CI success or an enGuide ending annotation as source-gate clearance. Keep PR draft/unmerged pending independent structural and accuracy passes.

VERIFICATION SETS AND OWNER EXCEPTION: The repository owner approved proceeding with a single written Japanese source for this title on 2026-11-03 (America/Chicago), with prior authorization documented at PR #102 comment https://github.com/kanjieater/VN-Guide/pull/102#issuecomment-6620496785 and reaffirmed in the user's task conversation. The exact title-scoped fact/limitation scope is in sayonara-wo-oshiete/prompt_supplement.md. Shisnap is the directly inspectable Japanese Set A and supplies the common opening, save checkpoints, main heroine selection sequences and named endings. Independent written Japanese reports corroborate partial structure and some choices but NONE supplies a complete parallel decision-to-ending chart. Missing Set B for those listed facts is therefore an acknowledged **owner-accepted one-source authoring limitation**, not a requirement to continue searching before drafting. Preserve authentic source attribution: omission placeholders mean missing second testimony, not independent verification. Shared-infrastructure PR #106 merged into main on 2026-11-04, so the canonical standards now permit title-scoped, provenance-backed one-source exceptions for VNs. This title's explicitly approved Set-B omission is therefore no longer a source-gate blocker for the enumerated facts. The exception is not evidence that a second source exists and does not waive missing choices, exact menu wording, 2016-edition applicability or independent reviews. The exception does not excuse incomplete route steps, inexact choice labels or unverified VJ009745 edition parity.

TARGET VERSION: All catalog/research/guide metadata targets the specific 2016-01-29 Windows DLsite VJ009745 release. The DLsite VJ009745 product description explicitly describes the 2016 Windows 10-compatible engine replacement, altered presentation effects, and newly supported message-back/load facilities; it does not explicitly claim to change main-story choices or route scripts (https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009745.html; quoted in Japanese at https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q12297473812). A 2016 Japanese written player report confirms that DL edition permits saving at choice screens (https://spoiler-alert.seesaa.net/article/463131708.html). Written reports of DL-purchased copies independently corroborate the basic five-heroine structure and ending behavior, but no direct written route comparison proves Set A's precise choices, affinity states and endings behave identically in VJ009745. A2 (exact-edition choice equivalence) remains blocking. A 2022 Japanese report mentions an uncertain CG difference; do not assume a specific removal.

PARTIAL LITERAL CHOICE CORROBORATION: The independent 2013 written Japanese completion report (https://sakurakameo.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-126.html) quotes the full option 彼女は天使であって天使ではない, while Set A abbreviates it to 彼女は天使であって…. Draft Mutsuki and Nozomi day-5 steps use the full quoted wording and identify its original-era provenance in enGuide. This does not establish that the 2016 edition displays the identical full text, and it does not fill the missing Set B for the remainder of either route. Other abbreviated choices likewise require exact-target verification.

CHECKPOINTS, ROUTE ORDER, ENDINGS: Set A explicitly documents save 1 at the start of day 4, save 2 at day 9 (Mutsuki/Mahiru branch), and save 3 at day 9 (Miyuki/Koyori branch). Proposed order is checkpoint-efficient, not a proven mandatory heroine unlock order or a universal spoiler-minimizing order. Day-10/11 continuation and each named ending are documented by Set A; because these are not player choices, current draft routes describe them only in the terminal enGuide rather than inventing an END selection in simpleJp. Separate Japanese reports describe the shared overall ending/epilogue despite heroine-specific route branches. Re-review the structure with this source-backed interpretation.

NON-MAIN ENDING AND OPTIONAL CONTENT: Japanese written reports describe a no-heroine/failed-affinity BAD END, but do not give a reproducible full prefix/checkpoint and terminal under the exact target. No badEndPath is invented. Reports indicate affinity can depend on early visits and choices; choosing the heroine at day 9 without a suitable prefix is not reliably sufficient. CG/recollection scene labels are not selectable choices and must not be emitted as simpleJp instructions.

IMAGES AND EVIDENCE POLICY: Character portraits have individually inspected YMGal character-source links. The exact-edition cover was actively searched without reliable VJ009745 attribution; cover_url deliberately remains empty rather than using a 2001 package photo. Chinese walkthroughs and gameplay videos, screenshots, streams, recording captions/transcripts or video descriptions do not count as a Japanese written verification lane; none is used as Set A/B evidence. No shared infrastructure/generated site files are edited in this title PR.
